raw.commentary: Layer is dominated by two master-retellings (Awakening and Identity Crisis) that duplicate most of the film, inflating membership and destroying non-redundancy; Rescue and Betrayal are causally tight and disciplined but are cannibalized by the master plots, leaving overall causal integrity and perspective discipline low despite locally complete arcs.
